title: Longitudinal pilot matrices
summary: Prepare three full compatibility matrices and the explicit zero-series boundary while transferring no values and admitting no series.
record_scope: Append-only Phase 160 record over the immutable Phase 145–156 v1-RC baseline.
publication_boundaries: The Phase 157–164 overlay adds operating plans and bounded content without rewriting the immutable Phase 145–156 release candidate.
Future September checks, desk decisions, edition inputs, publication receipts, and month-end findings remain null until their lawful dates.
Alternative official artifacts remain candidate pointers unless a dated authorized adjudication admits them; discovery is not evidence admission.
No project stage, longitudinal observation, outcome, causal finding, score, rank, owner decision, repository publication, hosted deployment, or v1 promotion is inferred.

pilot_matrices.title: Explicit zero-series launch boundary
pilot_matrices.proposed_scope: v1 may launch without longitudinal claims if every one of the 39 reviews is disclosed, every trend/outcome/comparison surface states zero admitted series, and a dated owner receipt accepts that boundary.
pilot_matrices.decisive_next_action: Obtain one dated owner disposition: admit only a Phase 69–70-compatible pilot or explicitly accept the disclosed zero-series boundary.
pilot_matrices.stop_rule: The absence of an admitted series forbids trends, outcome claims, rankings, scores, and causal comparisons.
